newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania kicks off second polio immunisation round.
newsitem.headline: Albania kicks off second polio immunisation round.

text.p: Albania's health ministry on Tuesday urged the Balkan nation's population to take part in the second stage of a polio immunisation programme starting next week to combat an epidemic which began in April.

The first stage covered around 95 percent of the population. The second vaccine with booster doses would reinforce the first and give people lifelong immunity from the disease, health authorities said.

"We call on people not to hesitate to take the second vaccine because that's the only way they will be completely safe from polio," a ministry official was quoted as saying on Albanian state television.

Albania launched a large-scale immunisation campaign in October, helped by international organisations, to halt a polio outbreak which is repoorted to have claimed 13 lives. The latest victim, a 28-year old pregnant woman from northern Albania, died this week, Albanian media reported.
The immunisation drive was aimed primarily at Albanians up to the age of 50 as the virus has been particularly prevalent among adults. Over 100 cases have been reported so far.
Medical experts have blamed a sub-standard vaccine made in Albania and dating back to the 1960s for the outbreak.
